assessment: All reports and metrics verified. The estimate is small and order-dependent: candidate loses 14/24 AB pairs and wins 17/24 BA pairs; AB median delta is positive and BA is negative. This narrow same-host public-runtime microbenchmark does not establish a robust general speedup.

checks.check: all raw hashes, 3 samples each, p50/p95 recomputed
exact workload metadata and all semantic oracle values
attempt journals and binary/helper pre/post hashes match
all pair deltas, order schedule, and report aggregate recomputed
source-map/build provenance independently checked in preceding source pass (2,197 paths per arm)

protocol.runtime_environment_caveat: Only LC_ALL=C, TZ=UTC, and the absolute report-path override are journaled; runner inherits the parent environment.

semantic_scope.p95_caveat: max of only three samples, not a stable tail estimate
semantic_scope.per_invocation_metric: median of 3 timed public runtime::run calls
semantic_scope.timer_boundary: Instant directly brackets runtime::run; registry/source setup and RunResult destruction are outside the timed interval.
